english.note: This is the usual choice for a technique that depends on skill or know-how.
This is the all-purpose choice for a virtuoso's technical skill and fluent technique.
This is the all-purpose noun for skill or technique, including skill in a particular art or trade.
Use this for a particular technique or method of doing something well.
Use this for the skill or technique involved in doing something rather than for art as a field.
